title: Han Lie Executed
next_chapter_hook: Before Han Lie died, his mad laughter echoed above the execution platform, and those words coiled like a venomous snake into Chen Ji's ears—Cang Yutian, the youngest Pillar of State in the Great Qin Dynasty, the last and most dangerous piece in Chen Ji's grand chess game of the world, was about to appear.

text.content:
Above the execution platform, the wind and clouds changed color.

Chen Ji slowly straightened up, the狼狈 caused by Han Lie's imposing aura completely gone. He brushed off the non-existent dust from his robes, a faint smile playing at the corner of his lips, his gaze toward Han Lie like looking at a cornered beast. "Senior Brother Han, what was it you just said?" His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached every person present, "That the evidence of atrash is worthless?"

dialogue.content: Han Lie's face turned ashen, forcing himself to calm down: "What are you trying to say? Does a servant disciple deserve to make noise here? In front of the imperial envoys, you truly don't know the height of the heavens!"

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his expression even carrying a hint of pity: "Senior Brother Han, you've been acting for so many years, aren't you tired?" He stepped forward slowly, each step踩在 Han Lie's heartstrings, "Colluding with the Demonic Path, harming fellow disciples, secretly communicating with foreign enemies... these crimes, did you think no one knew?"

dialogue.content: Han Lie's pupils contracted sharply, then he burst into fierce laughter: "Slander! Who would believe the words of atrash? Even if I kill you today, who would dare say even half a word!" He abruptly mobilized his spiritual energy, a violent gust of气浪 rushing toward Chen Ji.

text.content:
Just as the gust was about to touch Chen Ji, an ancient and authoritative voice rang out from the void: "Enough."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly emerged from the Tianji Sword, silver hair like snow, robes fluttering, surrounded by pale golden runes. He looked down at Han Lie from above, eyes filled with pity: "The number one genius of Xuanwu Sect? Nothing but a jumping clown."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng waved his right hand, and a jade slip floated in mid-air: "This contains copies of secret correspondence between Han Lie and the Demonic Path over three years, along with the soul-selling contract he signed in his own hand. There is also ironclad evidence of him ordering the poisoning of seven Inner Disciples—everyone, please examine this."

text.content: Images from the jade slip appeared one by one, Han Lie's ferocious face, sinister schemes, scenes of secret dealings with people from the Demonic Path... ironclad evidence mountain-high, impossible to deny. The area above and below the execution platform erupted in uproar, those disciples who had been deceived by Han Lie showing shock and fury on their faces.

dialogue.content: Han Lie's face instantly turned white as paper, his body trembling violently. He abruptly pointed at Mo Xiansheng: "You... you're framing me! This jade slip is fake, it must be fake!" His voice carried a whimper, completely lacking the pride of a genius from days past.

text.content: Chen Ji watched Han Lie's loss of composure quietly, his eyes ice-cold. Once upon a time, this man had stepped on his head relying on false reputation, and now, he was nothing but a stray dog. He spoke softly: "Han Lie, do you remember the martial arts fragment you personally destroyed in the scripture library three years ago? That was a family heirloom of a fellow disciple."

dialogue.content: Han Lie raised his head abruptly, glaring at Chen Ji: "Who... who exactly are you?!"

choice.prompt: Han Lie asks about identity, how should Chen Ji reveal his true self?

choices.description: Publicly expose Chen Ji's name, letting everyone witness the glorious moment of thetrash turning the tables.
choices.visible_cost: Revealing identity early may attract more attention
choices.visible_reward: The joy of public humiliation is doubled, Han Lie's spirit completely collapses
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may be observing secretly

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his entire aura suddenly changing. He reached up and swept his hand across his face, revealing a handsome and resolute face—the very "trash" everyone believed had long died in the Demonic Path.

text.content: "My name is Chen Ji." His voice was not loud, yet it exploded like thunder, "Three years ago, you thought you eliminated the biggest hidden danger; three years later, I've come to take your head."

choices.description: Pronounce Han Lie's crimes with the identity of imperial envoys "Heavenly Fate Enforcer," neither startling the snake nor failing to rightfully execute the old enemy.
choices.visible_cost: Han Lie may not know who is hitting him
choices.visible_reward: Low-profile scheming completed, Ling Yuan's suspicion will decrease
choices.risk_hint: The joy of public humiliation is slightly discounted

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a golden seal from his sleeve, on which were inscribed the two characters "Heavenly Fate." He surveyed his surroundings, his voice clear and resonant: "By imperial decree, this one has come to supervise the sect. Now, in the name of 'Heavenly Fate Enforcer,' I pronounce judgment—Han Lie, your crimes are unforgivable."

text.content: Han Lie's eyes widened, his face filled with disbelief. Never could he have imagined that this wretch, whom he had trampled beneath his feet, had become an Enforcer of the realm.

choices.description: Not rushing to reveal his identity, but letting Mo Xiansheng expose Han Lie's crimes piece by piece, completely crushing this archenemy psychologically.
choices.visible_cost: Slightly slower pacing, building satisfaction requires patience
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie slowly collapses in despair, with torment reaching its peak

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped back, gesturing for Mo Xiansheng to continue. What he wanted was not simple death, but Han Lie collapsing piece by piece in despair—just as he had been plunged into the mud and despair years ago.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng understood his intention and continued to expose more evidence. Han Lie's complexion shifted from ashen to pallid, from pallid to gray, like a withered tree drained of all vitality.

Ling Yuan slowly ascended the execution platform, his beard and hair completely white, his face as still as an ancient well. When he appeared before Han Lie, the once-invincible Xuanwu prodigy was paralyzed, trembling all over.

dialogue.content: "Han Lie..." Ling Yuan's voice was calm as water. "This old man once regarded you as a promising talent." He paused, raising his right palm, a sharp sword aura gathering in his palm. "Unfortunately, you have disappointed this old man."

text.content: Han Lie's knees buckled as he fell to his knees, tears and mucus streaming down his face: "Spare my life, Sect Master! Spare my life! Your subordinate admits his mistakes, willing to redeem himself through meritorious service—" His former proud spirit had completely turned into pitiful cries for mercy.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan is about to execute Han Lie. Does Chen Ji have anything to say?

choices.description: Coldly watching Han Lie beg for mercy without saying a word. The death of an archenemy needs no words.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the opportunity for the final strike
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining a cold persona—the suppressed hatred appears even deeper

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze coldly fixed on Han Lie's wretched state. Three years of patience, three years of scheming—all now condensed into this silent gaze. He said nothing—some hatred needs no words.

text.content: Ling Yuan's gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, as if scrutinizing something, then shifted away.

choices.description: Walking up to Han Lie and speaking a classic dying line, giving this settlement a perfect conclusion.
choices.visible_reward: Extremely high-completeness face-slapping, making readers feel exhilarated

dialogue.content: Chen Ji walked slowly to Han Lie's front, squatted down to be at eye level with him. His voice was soft, soft enough that only Han Lie could hear: "Three years ago when you trampled me into the mud, did you ever imagine this day would come?"
Han Lie's pupils constricted sharply, his lips trembling, yet he couldn't utter a single word.

text.content: Ling Yuan said nothing more, his sword energy like a rainbow, slashing down in an instant. Blood splattered, Han Lie's head rolled to the ground, eyes wide open, dying with unwilling acceptance. That once proud number one genius of the Xuanwu Sect was now nothing but a cold corpse. Silence reigned over the entire execution platform.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng nodded slightly, his remnant soul beginning to slowly dissipate. Before departing, he looked at Chen Ji, a trace of relief flickering in his eyes: "Volume Three objective, complete. Next, you will face an even greater storm."

text.content: Just then, a mad shriek emanated from Han Lie's headless corpse—a wisp of divine soul trapped within the corpse, unleashing a curse in its final moment of existence.

dialogue.content: "Hahaha..." Han Lie's remnant soul let out a hideous laugh, each word like a poisoned needle, "Chen Ji! What does it matter if you kill me? Cang Yutian won't let you off! The Great Qin Dynasty won't let you off! Wait... just you wait!"

text.content: The laughter abruptly ceased, and that wisp of remnant soul completely vanished between heaven and earth. The wind on the execution platform seemed to grow colder. The expressions of the dynasty envoys became subtly uneasy—Cang Yutian, that name like a dark cloud, looming over everyone's heads. Chen Ji gazed at Han Lie's corpse, a trace of solemnity flickering in the depths of his eyes.

Cang Yutian... Chen Ji silently recited this name in his heart. Having orchestrated schemes across the realm for years, he naturally understood this person's significance—the youngest pillar of the Great Qin Dynasty, commanding three hundred thousand iron cavalry, rumored to have reached the half-step Great Master realm.

Chen Ji slowly turned around to face Ling Yuan and the dynasty envoys. His expression was calm, as if that curse just now was merely wind passing by his ears. "Everyone, Han Lie has been executed, evidence is conclusive, the case is closed." His voice was unhurried, "Now, it's time to discuss other matters."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan cast a deep glance at Chen Ji, that gaze seeming to hide something, yet it vanished in an instant. "Chen Ji, you did well." He left only these four words before turning to leave, his figure stretching long in the sunset's glow.

text.content: Chen Ji stood on the execution platform, gazing at Ling Yuan's departing back, a meaningful smile curving the corner of his mouth. Old fox... what are you probing for? He sneered in his heart. Three years of meticulous planning, Han Lie was merely a discarded piece—the real game of chess was just beginning.

choice.prompt: Han Lie has been executed, great vengeance achieved. Next, how should Chen Ji conclude the matter?

choices.text: When the deed is done, brush off one's robes and leave
choices.description: Hide one's achievements and fame, depart quietly amid the crowd's discussion without any hesitation.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to further consolidate the fruits of victory
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an air of mystery, leaving opponents unable to gauge one's true depths

dialogue.content: Chen Ji straightened his robes, gave a slight nod to the dynasty envoys, then turned and departed. His figure vanished into the crowd without drawing anyone's attention—as if that person who had turned the tide on the execution platform moments ago was merely an illusion.

text.content: It wasn't until he walked out of the crowd that Chen Ji's footsteps finally paused. He raised his gaze toward the horizon, where dark clouds were gathering—a mighty storm was about to arrive.

choices.text: While the iron is hot, consolidate one's position
choices.description: Stay at the scene, converse with the dynasty envoys, further cement the newly established authority, and顺便 gather intelligence on Cang Yutian.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more information to Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Gain the dynasty's resource倾斜, adding leverage for subsequent schemes

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't rush to leave. Instead, he walked toward the leader of the dynasty envoys. When that man saw him, a sharp light flickered in his eyes, and he took the initiative to cup his fists: "Chen Zhiling, your great name precedes you."

text.content: After the conversation, Chen Ji not only gained the favor of the Imperial Court, but also obtained an important piece of intelligence—Cang Yutian is currently in seclusion, attempting to break through to the Great Master realm. Once successful, his strength will rise to an even higher level.

As darkness fell, the bloodstains on the execution platform had been cleaned away, as if nothing had ever happened.

Chen Ji walked alone in the corridor, Han Lie's dying curse echoing in his mind. Cang Yutian... this name, he had already记在心中. Three years of meticulous planning, he had long grown accustomed to dancing with tigers.

Han Lie was dead, yet Chen Ji felt no anticipated joy. This was merely the first piece to fall on his chessboard. The true opponents—Ling Yuan, Cang Yutian, and even that Heavenly Dao's Eye hidden behind the scenes—were still far from revealing themselves.

Just then, a transmission talisman flew into Chen Ji's hand. Frowning slightly, he infused it with spiritual energy, and Su Qingyao's cold voice rang out: "Chen Ji, come to the Inner Sect Council Hall immediately. Cang Yutian's envoy has arrived."

Chen Ji gripped the talisman, his eyes flickering. How swift. He put away the talisman, straightened his robes, and a faint smile curved his lips: Since you've come, let's receive you.
